_doc: Reference inputs and llama.cpp reference numbers for tools/k3_smoke.py. Every number names its source. llama.cpp: ignite-llama build-hip-therock, llama-server on both cards (-sm layer -ts 550,450, -fa on, q8_0 KV, -ub 256, -lm dio), greedy (top_k 1, seed 1), ignore_eos, no prompt cache, prompt = the first 200 ids of each e2e text's tokens.txt (the same prompts k3_smoke uses). tok/s = llama-server's predicted_per_second (eval time only, prompt excluded). acceptance = draft_n_accepted / draft_n; tokens_per_pass = llama-server's 'mean len'. Draft max 3 for every speculative row (= K3 verify T = 4). JOB = the development job's scratch directory (ephemeral; archived under $ARTIFACTS/backups). The Coder's ref_dumps, JOB/m0/floor*.* and the JOB/m0 / JOB/m2/mtp sources below are copied to $ARTIFACTS/refs (d281-short, smoke-provenance; MANIFEST.md); the REAP-308 ref_dumps are not copied yet (MANIFEST.md says how).

coder.ref_dumps_source: tools/gg_golden one-token decode dumps of the Coder (q8_0 KV); the _batch siblings give the D-281 floor (llama.cpp batch vs decode on the same tokens)

plain.source: M0: JOB/m0/srv-none32k.log (bench256.py, rep 2 of each text). Shell rep 2 (38.00) is a low outlier: shell rep 1 was 43.81 and the MTP session's plain shell 43.94 (plain_mtp_session); the plan quotes plain as 44.2

dflash.source: M0: JOB/m0/srv-dflash32k.log (bench256.py, rep 2; DFlash2 Q8_0 on ROCm1, --spec-draft-n-max 3)

mtp1.source: MTP reference run: JOB/m2/mtp/res-mtp1.json (spec_client.py full, greedy rows; sidecar mtp-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Coder-MTP-IQ4_XS.gguf, --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 1)

plain_mtp_session.source: MTP reference run: JOB/m2/mtp/res-plain.json (same session as mtp1 / mtp3)

dflash_mtp_session.source: MTP reference run: JOB/m2/mtp/res-dflash3.json (same session as mtp1 / mtp3)

reap.ref_dumps_source: tools/gg_golden one-token decode dumps of REAP-308-UI (q8_0 KV); the _batch siblings give the D-281 floor
